sections.heading: Did You Know?
paragraph: Slow computers often improve after removing unwanted startup programs, malware, or misconfigured software.
Router placement, walls, and nearby electronics can weaken Wi-Fi, even with a fast internet plan.
Overheating, outdated drivers, and software conflicts can cause shutdowns, crashes, and printer problems.

sections.heading: Who This Helps
paragraph: On-site tech support is for homeowners and small businesses that need help with computers, Wi-Fi, printers, accounts, or connected devices.
It is also a good starting point when several problems are connected or you are not sure which service you need.

sections.heading: When to Choose On-Site Tech Support
items: Several devices have the same problem
A computer, printer, or smart device will not connect to Wi-Fi
You need in-person help setting up a new computer, printer, phone, tablet, or smart device
The problem is difficult to explain or reproduce remotely
You are not sure whether the cause is the device, software, account, or network

sections.heading: What We Do
paragraph: We diagnose the problem where it occurs and focus on the issues that matter most during the visit.
items: Troubleshoot computers, printers, Wi-Fi, accounts, and connected devices
Set up new equipment and connect it to your existing network and accounts
Fix settings and connection problems across devices or rooms
Explain what caused the problem and what to do next
Recommend a more specific service if the job requires repair, data recovery, or malware removal

sections.heading: When Another Service May Be a Better Fit
paragraph: Choose On-Site Tech Support when you need broad, in-person help or several issues may be connected. For a slow, damaged, or non-booting computer, choose [Computer Repair](/services/computer-repair). For Wi-Fi coverage, router, or network problems, choose [Wi-Fi and Network Setup](/services/network-setup). For help after a scam or suspicious message, choose [Scam and Fraud Protection](/services/scam-protection).

sections.heading: Local Availability
paragraph: On-site tech support is available for homes and small businesses in Ocala, Belleview, The Villages, and nearby Central Florida communities. We explain the problem, your options, and the cost before work begins.

faq.question: Do you come to my home?
faq.answer: Yes. We provide on-site service for homes and small businesses in Ocala, Belleview, The Villages, and nearby Central Florida communities.

faq.question: Can you help with more than one issue during a visit?
faq.answer: Yes, when time allows. We will help you prioritize related issues and address the most important problems first.

faq.question: What if I am not sure which service I need?
faq.answer: Choose On-Site Tech Support if you want in-person help and do not yet know whether the problem involves the device, software, account, or network.
